main_subject.detail: A corporate sales-announcement poster with text 'TOYOTA VIET NAM CONG BO DOANH SO THANG 6/2026'. Giant glossy red numerals '6717' dominate the center, followed by 'XE DA BAN RA*'. A white Toyota Innova Cross is parked on the right in front of a glowing waterfront skyline. Bottom-left note says '(*) Da bao gom doanh so cua Lexus'. Top-right Toyota logo and bottom-right script read 'Move your world'.
